Building in a filesystem on a loop device on a tmpfs file can hang when
swapping
column2: the loop thread caught in that infamous throttle_vm_writeout.

column1: In theory this is a long standing problem
column2: which I've either never seen in

column1: practice
column2: or long ago suppressed the recollection

column1: and my tmpfs size as unrealistically high.  But now
become easy to hang on one machine.
Loop used to grab_cache_page before the old prepare_write to tmpfs
seems to have been enough to free up some memory for any swapin needed; but
the new write_begin lets tmpfs find or allocate the page (much nicer
grab_cache_page missed tmpfs pages in swapcache).
When allocating a fresh page
has __GFP_IO|__GFP_FS stripped off
break out when __GFP_IO or GFP_FS is unset; but when tmfps swaps in
read_swap_cache_async allocates with GFP_HIGHUSER_MOVABLE regardless of the
mapping_gfp_mask - hence the hang.
So
column2: pass gfp_mask down the line from shmem_getpage to shmem_swapin to

column1: swapin_readahead to read_swap_cache_async to add_to_swap_cache.
